title: Storm Sorceress on Clouds
description: A purple-haired sorceress in flowing white and purple robes stands on a broken wooden dock floating among storm clouds. She holds a glowing blue staff in one hand and casts a swirling green portal with the other, while a spectral white figure emerges from a vortex above and various fantasy characters fly or fall around her in a dramatic sky filled with lightning.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a powerful sorceress with long flowing purple hair standing on a broken wooden dock suspended in stormy clouds. She wears white and purple robes and holds a glowing blue staff while casting a swirling green magical portal. A large purple and green swirling vortex with lightning fills the sky above her, and a translucent white ghostly figure spirals out from it. Multiple smaller fantasy characters in colorful attire fly and fall through the air around her, some with weapons. Lightning bolts strike in the background with dramatic lighting and dynamic composition.
